11029|28ea6aca.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|28ea6aca.text: You'll need to prove your worthiness before I go giving away my secrets! I've got just the test for you...

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

251371|c4bcd3c9.name: Falorne Fallwind
251371|c4bcd3c9.text: Greetings to you, fellow High Order initiate.

251507|af6809a8.name: Josephine Carson
251507|af6809a8.text: Greetings $c, I can teach you skills and techniques.

251905|48ad85dc.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|48ad85dc.text: Ho there, traveler! New to town? Well, once you get settled in come see me if you'd like some work. I've been working overtime preparing for the Festival of Winds and I'll take all the help I can get keeping the larders full!

251968|4f475817.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|4f475817.text:
<Ayessa Dawnsinger eyes you with barely-contained fury.> 

You are either very bold, or very stupid to so brazenly step foot into our domain after spilling Windshaper blood. We are slow to forgive, and we never forget. 

You should remove yourself from here at once. If we weren't in the center of Zephras, you would already be dead.

251968|51e58459.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|51e58459.text:
Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The Windshapers will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

<Ayessa lowers her voice dangerously.> 

Do not mistake our cooperation for any sort of forgiveness. You owe the Windshapers blood, and someday we will collect.

252475|53576371.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|53576371.text:
I see. This seems dangerous in the extreme, but the situation seems to demand that risks be taken.

Very well, the High Order will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

252475|58724dc1.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|58724dc1.text:
The Windshapers are almost wholly to blame for everything that has happened. Their refusal to change has damaged our ability to save ourselves from our current peril. They speak in absolutes and treat assumptions and superstitious hope as fact.

Do you know who else deals only absolutes? The Al'Aketh. 

I for one do not intend to let blind adherence to dangerous beliefs doom our people. If it weren't for the threat of the cult, I'd march our mages over to the other side of Valnaar and wipe the Windshapers out.

253004|1a6886aa.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

253004|d62b45b0.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

253474|28030f47.name: Peacekeeper
253474|28030f47.text: You can find the cooking trainer in a small house on the north end of town.

253474|823817d9.name: Peacekeeper
253474|823817d9.text:
Engineer? What in Skywall is that?

Now that you mention it... I think I may have heard that drunk Sirrocas over at the inn talking about some sort of forest spirit that he claimed to have encountered that called itself an "engineer."

That was the first I'd ever heard of such a thing.

I believe he said that this particular spirit could be found somewhere in Shadowgale Forest, but I can't recommend you go to that cursed place!

253847|6ace422f.name: Elaadrin Evengale
253847|6ace422f.text:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

254100|6be7d7dd.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|6be7d7dd.text:
The Al'Aketh cult claims that Al'Akir the "Windlord" will save us from our current woes here on Zephras. If Al'Akir is real and really is the ruler of Skywall, why did the wind spirits refuse to speak of him for so long?

Either he isn't real, or even worse, he's real and he's not as benevolent as the cult claims him to be. Either way, nothing about what the cult is doing is good for us normal folk.

254411|d56cf43b.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
254411|d56cf43b.text:
You can't teach an old dog new tricks.  At least that's what someone once told me.  Lucky for you, I've discovered it to be untrue.

However, pets do tend to get resistant to the technique, and I need more food each time to keep them happy.  What that means is that you'll owe me more money the more times I untrain the same pet.

Now then, would you like me to start untraining?

257008|c65683ed.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257008|d62b45b0.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257022|4fed1ed6.name: Messana Crestwind
257022|4fed1ed6.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things. 

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner them I'm your shen'dorei.

259084|637067e7.name: Denaaris Stargale
259084|637067e7.text: Wind's greetings, friend. I've been authorized to offer fellow $R quick passage to the city of Stormwind. Please feel free to utilize this portal at your leisure.

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

270581|e6b98502.name: Fyrenz Vishonar
270581|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

274781|ce6a7b9d.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

275269|d9943d35.name: High Order Dockmaster
275269|d9943d35.text: Board here for transport to Dalaran City, nestled in the Alterac Mountains.

275270|fb00a823.name: Windshapers Dockmaster
275270|fb00a823.text: All travelers bound for Mulgore should depart here.

275491|0edd6da8.name: Randal Emerson
275491|0edd6da8.text: Greetings, citizen. How may I help you today?

275491|9fd8120c.name: Randal Emerson
275491|9fd8120c.text:
Ah yes, he mentioned that an agent of the High Order would be arriving in Stormwind soon. He asked me to draft instructions for you.

<Randal hands you a neatly sealed note.>

This should give you all the information you need. You are in for quite the journey, $N. I wish you luck on behalf of Stormwind and the Alliance.

276170|e50e47b5.name: Belanaa Windveil
276170|e50e47b5.text: I am Belanaa Windveil and I am an agent of the High Order here on Azeroth. If you'd like to make a donation of cloth to our organization, we would be most grateful.

2784|a2f26445.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
2784|a2f26445.text:
Ah, so you have. You are most welcome in Ironforge, $c. 

This city is the seat of the Bronzebeard Clan. We are an ancient and proud people and our craftsmen are second to none. You'll find no finer creations of metal or stonework than dwarven-make.

We are also amongst boldest of explorers on Azeroth. If you have a taste for adventure, you will be in good company amongst our people.

Thank you for speaking with me, $N. Go now with the blessings of the Bronzebeard Clan. 

I wish you and your people well.

28989|0a03e13c.name: Aemara
28989|0a03e13c.text:
I'm hoping to open my very own shop soon! In the meantime, would you like to buy anything?

Every bit counts towards funding my dream!

415|26f5a1f4.name: Verner Osgood
415|26f5a1f4.text: Hey ma'am, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

68|27751eb6.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|27751eb6.text: Go to the Mage Quarter and seek out Fyrenz Stargazer, just northwest of the mage tower.

7937|51417c16.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|51417c16.text: Hello there, $c. I am High Tinker Mekkatorque of the exiles of Gnomeregan.

7937|98814444.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|98814444.text:
Oh yes, how wonderful! I have been expecting an emissary from your people, and I am very happy to make your acquaintance.

I do wish I could receive you in our home city of Gnomeregan, but our people have recently fallen on hard times and our homeland is, at present, lost to us.

King Bronzebeard is ever a friend to we gnomes however, and has graciously opened his city to us in this difficult time. 

I hope that your adventures on Azeroth treat you well, and I look forward to further opportunities to learn more of your people. 

Farewell, $N.

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

107-accept.name: Gramma Stonefield
107-accept.text:
I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
107-accept.title: Note to William

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

15-accept.name: Marshal McBride
15-accept.text:
$N, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.

Go to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
15-accept.title: Investigate Echo Ridge

1688-progress.name: Gakin the Darkbinder
1688-progress.text: Even the older and wiser can be unmanned by the wiles of youth and beauty, $N. A piece of advice you would do well to remember throughout your life.
1688-progress.title: Surena Caledon

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

18-accept.name: Deputy Willem
18-accept.text:
Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.

I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
18-accept.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

2158-accept.name: Falkhaan Isenstrider
2158-accept.text:
Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!

My best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.

To find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!
2158-accept.title: Rest and Relaxation

2158-complete.name: Innkeeper Farley
2158-complete.text:
Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.

Would you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?
2158-complete.title: Rest and Relaxation

33-complete.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-complete.text:
You've been busy!  I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...

I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
33-complete.title: Wolves Across the Border

35-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
35-accept.text:
If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas.  He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.

Bring me his report.
35-accept.title: Further Concerns

3903-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3903-complete.text:
Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me?  He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

Perhaps you can help me?
3903-complete.title: Milly Osworth

3904-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3904-accept.text:
A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates!  Save my harvest!
3904-accept.title: Milly's Harvest

3904-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3904-complete.text:
Oh thank you, $N!  You saved my harvest!  And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.

We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
3904-complete.title: Milly's Harvest

3905-complete.name: Brother Neals
3905-complete.text:
Let's see here...

Oh my!  Milly's grapes have been saved!  When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!

And through your bravery,  we now have grapes for more wine!  May the Light bless you, $N, and keep you safe!
3905-complete.title: Grape Manifest

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

40-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
40-complete.text:
Yes, I spoke with Remy.  I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.

Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
40-complete.title: A Fishy Peril

5261-complete.name: Eagan Peltskinner
5261-complete.text: That's true.  I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves!  Are you that person?
5261-complete.title: Eagan Peltskinner

54-accept.name: Marshal McBride
54-accept.text:
$N, you are a $c with proven interest in the security of Northshire.  You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest.

If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.  Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
54-accept.title: Report to Goldshire

54-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
54-complete.text:
Well, it says here that you've been awarded Acting Deputy Status with the Stormwind Marshals.  Congratulations.

And good luck - keeping Elwynn safe is no picnic... what with most the army busy doing who knows what for who knows which noble!

It's hard to keep track of politics in these dark days...
54-complete.title: Report to Goldshire

6-accept.name: Deputy Willem
6-accept.text:
Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge.  Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty!

But be wary, $N.  Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him.  He will not be an easy man to reach.
6-accept.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

60-complete.name: William Pestle
60-complete.text: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you?  Thanks for the candles, $N, and here's your reward...
60-complete.title: Kobold Candles

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

783-complete.name: Marshal McBride
783-complete.text:
Ah, good.  Another volunteer.  We're getting a lot of you these days.

I hope it's enough.

The $r lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad.  This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.

It is a many-fronted battle we wage, $N.  Gird yourself for a long campaign.
783-complete.title: A Threat Within

79093-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79093-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79093-progress.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works

84-accept.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
84-accept.text: Here you go.  And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!
84-accept.title: Back to Billy

84-complete.name: Billy Maclure
84-complete.text:
Mm, yum!  This pie is the best!

I think my memory is coming back to me...
84-complete.title: Back to Billy

85-accept.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
85-accept.text:
I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it!  He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here. 

Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
85-accept.title: Lost Necklace

86-complete.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-complete.text: Though this wild boar meat is tough, simmer it enough and it sure does make for some tasty pie!
86-complete.title: Pie for Billy

87-accept.name: Billy Maclure
87-accept.text:
I was playing near the Fargodeep Mine, and I think I dropped, er...I mean I saw, the old lady's necklace.  Don't ask me how it got there...it wasn't me!

Well anyway, I saw this big, gold-toothed kobold pick up the necklace and run into the mine.  Go find that kobold and you'll find the necklace, I swear!
87-accept.title: Goldtooth

88-accept.name: Ma Stonefield
88-accept.text:
The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess.  The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!

So before she comes to our fields...Princess must die!  Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!

Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm.  Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
88-accept.title: Princess Must Die!

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

91743-accept.name: Brother Paxton
91743-accept.text: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743-accept.title: Rascally Rodents

91745-complete.name: Kelsey Fargo
91745-complete.text: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
91745-complete.title: Mining Consultant

91758-accept.name: Marshal McBride
91758-accept.text:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758-accept.title: Follow That Kobold!

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91777-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
91777-accept.text:
There's just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
91777-accept.title: Rare Books

91777-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91777-complete.text: Oh, $N! Thank you so much for saving my library. You've done me an amazing service. Please take one of these fine weapons. They were intended for the militia, but you can make better use of them.
91777-complete.title: Rare Books

92124-complete.name: Daniel
92124-complete.text:
Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.

It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.

While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.
92124-complete.title: Book Inventory

92462-accept.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92462-accept.text:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462-accept.title: Infestation Investigation

92463-complete.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-complete.text: Excellent work, $N. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.
92463-complete.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92464-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92464-accept.text:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them. 

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
92464-accept.title: Elemental Unrest

92464-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92464-complete.text: Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.
92464-complete.title: Elemental Unrest

92465-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, $c?
92465-accept.title: Agitators

92465-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-complete.text: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.
92465-complete.title: Agitators

92469-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92469-accept.text:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469-accept.title: Return to Rorian

92469-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92469-complete.text:
This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.

You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, $N. Thank you.
92469-complete.title: Return to Rorian

92470-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-accept.text:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the south. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470-accept.title: Foul Matriarch

92473-progress.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-progress.text: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?
92473-progress.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92474-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92474-complete.text:
How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our $r gifts!

That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.

In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.
92474-complete.title: Falling With Style

92515-progress.name: Indari Sunseam
92515-progress.text: If you ask me, I think Prideclaws are actually kind of cute. From a safe distance... and while standing behind someone holding a sword, of course.
92515-progress.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92517-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92517-complete.text:
With the bandits dispersed, that is one less problem for us to deal with. Though I confess that now I worry that any bandits who survived may turn next to the cult for protection, further bolstering their increasingly alarming numbers.

Still though, we'll take the victories where we can get them.
92517-complete.title: The Criminal Element

92528-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92528-complete.text:
Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!

If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?

The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.

Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.
92528-complete.title: Among the Faithful

92529-accept.name: Sania Silverstream
92529-accept.text:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.
92529-accept.title: Falaath Village

92529-complete.name: Missionary Jasaan
92529-complete.text:
What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!

We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.
92529-complete.title: Falaath Village

92550-progress.name: Constable Aonda
92550-progress.text: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.
92550-progress.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92551-progress.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-progress.text: There's a lot of hungry and desperate $r here who need these supplies.
92551-progress.title: Stolen Supplies

92553-complete.name: Zerril Softbreeze
92553-complete.text:
These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.

If you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.
92553-complete.title: Restocking the Larders

92596-complete.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-complete.text:
The High Order's mission is vital to the survival of our people. We hold our elemental benefactors in the utmost regard, but we must face reality; they are gone now, and we are on our own.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and uncertainties of our security on this plane, it is our destiny as Highborne descendants of our ancestral home of Eldre'Thalas to use our gifts to ensure that the shen'dorei can stand on our own once again.
92596-complete.title: The High Order

92597-accept.name: Falorne Fallwind
92597-accept.text:
Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from ley lines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these ley lines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.

Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a ley line there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
92597-accept.title: Reading the Ley Lines

92597-complete.name: Falorne Fallwind
92597-complete.text:
Do you feel it? Yes? Good! You have taken your first steps. You'll find that with your abilities, you will be able to tap into latent magical energy in many locations. Doing so will provide a myriad of benefits, some profound, others more subtle. You won't know until you tap into them, But that's the best part of the gift... making the unknown known.

If we are to survive these dire times, we must be unwavering in our search for knowledge... and power.
92597-complete.title: Reading the Ley Lines

92644-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92644-complete.text:
The turncoat was already dead when you arrived, you say? This is unfortunate news.

<You hand over the crystal you found on the dead cultist's body.>

Interesting...
92644-complete.title: Unfortunate News

92645-accept.name: Yorana Windyreed
92645-accept.text:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.
92645-accept.title: Breaking the Breaker

92645-complete.name: Yorana Windyreed
92645-complete.text:
Belguilos is dead? Four winds bless you, $c. 

We might just make it out of this alive after all.
92645-complete.title: Breaking the Breaker

92679-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92679-complete.text:
<Aamelia listens while you explain what became of Alvarion.>

At least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.

Stranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.
92679-complete.title: Blood Tithe

92682-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-accept.text:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
92682-accept.title: Make Yourself Useful

92682-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-complete.text: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.
92682-complete.title: Make Yourself Useful

92682-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-progress.text: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.
92682-progress.title: Make Yourself Useful

92683-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-complete.text:
This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.

Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.
92683-complete.title: Flutterfly Dust

92683-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-progress.text: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.
92683-progress.title: Flutterfly Dust

92684-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-accept.text:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
92684-accept.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92684-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-complete.text: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.
92684-complete.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92684-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-progress.text: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... well, too long.
92684-progress.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92685-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-accept.text:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685-accept.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92685-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-progress.text:
If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.

<Aamelia laughs loudly.>
92685-progress.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92693-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-accept.text:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.
92693-accept.title: Standing Our Ground

92698-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92698-complete.text:
The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though.

In the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days.
92698-complete.title: What Is My Purpose?

92701-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92701-accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to the Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $N.
92701-accept.title: To Valanaar

92703-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92703-accept.text:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, $N. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
92703-accept.title: Deliver the News

92703-complete.name: Alvarion Windfield
92703-complete.text:
<Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>

I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall. 

I'll never forget what you did for us, $N. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.
92703-complete.title: Deliver the News

92709-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92709-complete.text:
So do you now see? Rediscovering the ancient magic of our forebears is the key to unlocking the secrets of Zephras Isle and securing our future, but in order to save our home, we must rediscover what we've lost these past millennia.

Azeroth is the key. The Kirin Tor will show us the way.

While we make ready to leave, you should check in with the other members of the High Order here in Valanaar. Most of them have tasks that they could use help from one such as yourself to see completed.
92709-complete.title: A Grand Adventure

92727-accept.name: Dondallion Whisperwind
92727-accept.text:
Seeking knowledge is the primary mandate of the High Order, but this work has never been more dangerous than it is now on Zephras.

One of our scholars--Fillion Flamebreeze--was en route to the Shen'dar Highlands to gather data on the windborne magic that congregates in some areas there. Regrettably, he has not returned and we fear that something may have befallen him on the road.

If you can, please locate him for us. He was last seen on the road leading west from Valanaar towards Shen'dar Highlands.
92727-accept.title: The Missing Scholar

92741-complete.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-complete.text:
That is quite the haul of talons you've brought me. I cannot wait to dig into this!

Thank you for your service to the High Order, $c.
92741-complete.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92741-progress.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-progress.text: The High Order does not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
92741-progress.title: Unwelcome Visitors

92834-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92834-accept.text:
When the cult began their campaign of violence, the Peacekeepers and Windshapers responded with posturing. I saw this as foolish escalation so I advocated for peaceful dialogue. Yesterday I dispatched my friend Belathaan Brightwish to the Shrine of Akir, hoping to establish that dialogue.

A box just arrived containing Belathaan's tongue, dipped in silver pigment. 

Its clear to me now that there is no reasoning with the cult. Kill any cultists you see, and bring me the prayer charms that they carry.
92834-accept.title: Avenged Tenfold

92834-progress.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92834-progress.text: I don't agree with the Windshapers often, but they were right to dismiss the idea of trying to engage peacefully with the Al'Aketh. My attempt to take the high road cost a dear friend his life and is a mistake I will have to live with for the rest of my days.
92834-progress.title: Avenged Tenfold

92840-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92840-complete.text:
It would not have been my preference to spill Windshaper blood but the blame for this pointless conflict rests solely on their shoulders. We sought to peacefully gather information, and they responded with violence.

Unfortunately, word has spread and the Windshapers are already calling it a 'massacre'. They wouldn't dare to retaliate here in Valanaar, but they will certainly not forget.

$N, you have been of tremendous aid to the High Order. Thank you.
92840-complete.title: Catching Wind

92849-accept.name: Unknown
92849-accept.text: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>
92849-accept.title: The Missing Scholar

92849-complete.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92849-complete.text:
Th... thank you, stranger. I was returning from an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones when I was suddenly ambushed and attacked by Windshapers. They forced me over to the mouth of the cave and left me there, barely conscious and bleeding. The last thing I remember before blacking out is a massive winged beast emerging from the cave and scooping me up.

I think it's safe to say that if you hadn't come along, I'd have been dinner for that beast and its younglings.
92849-complete.title: The Missing Scholar

92860-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92860-complete.text:
I am sorry to hear about Belathaan. He was actually my cousin and he was a good mage and servant of Zephras. We will avenge him.

You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.
92860-complete.title: In Service of Zephras

92880-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92880-complete.text:
<Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.>

Thank the winds.
92880-complete.title: Return to Valanaar

92881-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92881-accept.text:
The attack on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881-accept.title: The High Elder's Request

92881-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92881-complete.text: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.
92881-complete.title: The High Elder's Request

92947-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92947-accept.text:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the Windshapers and High Order in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.
92947-accept.title: Making Our Move

93065-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93065-accept.text: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065-accept.title: Prepare for Battle

93089-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
93089-accept.text:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, his mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, $N.
93089-accept.title: What Comes Next

93089-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
93089-complete.text:
It gladdens me to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Ansirem has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between the city of Dalaran and Zephras Isle. We've done as much testing as we can, and the time has come for our vanguard to depart.
93089-complete.title: What Comes Next

93159-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93159-accept.text:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... its um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?
93159-accept.title: The Strange Hermit

93165-accept.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93165-accept.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93165-complete.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-complete.text:
Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.

I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears bring them here.
93165-complete.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93165-progress.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-progress.text: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.
93165-progress.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93317-progress.name: Nyalah Brightfire
93317-progress.text:
Windsong Crawler meat is common enough here but it was something of a delicacy on the islands of Anvilas and Siroccas. Was a time, back when the skystreams were open that the locals would mob me for the stuff when I'd make the trip to Shen'dramar or New Eldre'naar.

Not been able to visit those places in... well... a long time.
93317-progress.title: Crab Season

93318-complete.name: Danarii Bellowveil
93318-complete.text: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.
93318-complete.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93319-accept.name: Teeri Wellwind
93319-accept.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day to day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
93319-accept.title: Pilfered Windstones

93320-complete.name: Yorana Windyreed
93320-complete.text: We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast.
93320-complete.title: Tower Defense

93926-complete.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
93926-complete.text: <The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, its clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.>
93926-complete.title: The Western Watch

93927-accept.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
93927-accept.text: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>
93927-accept.title: A Last Request

93949-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93949-accept.text:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.
93949-accept.title: Bugged

93949-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
93949-complete.text: I'm sure there are more of these critters around Valanaar, but every enchanted skyhopper we stomp out makes the city just a tiny bit safer.
93949-complete.title: Bugged

93963-accept.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
93963-accept.text:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963-accept.title: Exploring the Alliance

94013-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-accept.text:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts, it's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the $c.
94013-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94013-complete.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-complete.text:
Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.

Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the $c that Zephras Isle needs you to be.
94013-complete.title: Taming the Beast

94013-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94013-progress.title: Taming the Beast

94050-complete.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
94050-complete.text:
A fledgling $c, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
94050-complete.title: Training the Beast

94369-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
94369-accept.text:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
94369-accept.title: The Fate of Zephras

94369-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94369-complete.text:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.
94369-complete.title: The Fate of Zephras

94413-complete.name: Rathiril Sunlance
94413-complete.text:
Sometimes I find it hard to distinguish between the blind zealotry of the Al'Aketh cult, and the stubborn refusal of the Windshapers to change.

If they truly believed the winds would guide us, they should be sensing the direction the winds are blowing and flow with them rather than against them.
94413-complete.title: A Magical Affront

94484-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94484-complete.text:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.>

So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then.

It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94484-complete.title: Unnerving Silence

94485-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94485-complete.text:
<Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.>

Thank you, $N, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.
94485-complete.title: Tears of the Lady

94486-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94486-progress.text: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.
94486-progress.title: Feathers for Binding

94487-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-accept.text:
The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds in-between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487-accept.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94487-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94487-progress.text: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.
94487-progress.title: Unwanted and Unworthy

94488-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94488-complete.text:
<Elegael grimaces at the severed head, but nods curtly.>

Thank you, $N. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin.

Do not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.
94488-complete.title: The Ties That Bind

94488-progress.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94488-progress.text: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?
94488-progress.title: The Ties That Bind

94489-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94489-accept.text:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
94489-accept.title: The Wounds of Betrayal

94489-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94489-complete.text:
<Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>

No... no! This is far worse than I had--

<Elegael chokes back a sob, and grits her teeth letting out a pained snarl.>

They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.
94489-complete.title: The Wounds of Betrayal

94490-complete.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94490-complete.text:
They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack?

<Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.>

They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives.

Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired.
94490-complete.title: Ripped Missive

94491-accept.name: Elegael Thornpaw
94491-accept.text:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, thought the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, $N. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
94491-accept.title: The Fate of the Den

94896-complete.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94896-complete.text: Thank you, $c, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.
94896-complete.title: Aid For The Refugees

94896-progress.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94896-progress.text: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.
94896-progress.title: Aid For The Refugees

94897-accept.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94897-accept.text:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
94897-accept.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94897-complete.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
94897-complete.text:
<Ealaane's eyes well with tears.>

Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started.

Thank you, $c. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.
94897-complete.title: The Fate of a Loved One

94946-complete.name: Denaaris Stargale
94946-complete.text:
Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper.  

As idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.
94946-complete.title: The Magical City of Dalaran

94947-accept.name: Denaaris Stargale
94947-accept.text:
Its a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.
94947-accept.title: Welcome to Azeroth

94947-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
94947-complete.text:
Well met, $c. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.

A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect to recieve members of the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.

On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, $R.
94947-complete.title: Welcome to Azeroth

94978-complete.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94978-complete.text: Well tamed, $N! You are becoming adept already.
94978-complete.title: Taming the Beast

94979-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94979-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94979-progress.title: Taming the Beast

96101-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it, urging you to seek out an Earthseer named "Farsen".>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96391-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96391-complete.text:
Judging by this map, it certainly looks like these Dark Irons are planning some sort of incursion into the vaults beneath Ironforge. The band ye busted up to the east must be a scouting force.

Thank ye for bringing me this. If we hurry, we might be able to beat them to whatever their goal is down there.
96391-complete.title: Underground Map

96393-complete.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
96393-complete.text:
A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched.

The guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible.

Thank ye for yer service to Ironforge,$c. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.
96393-complete.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96394-complete.name: Afadra Dunwall
96394-complete.text: Ah good, its done then. I can't have the other keepers refusing to enter the hall to do their duties on account of "ghosts" and "angry dead", can I?
96394-complete.title: The Restless Dead

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-complete.name: Thom Filch
96403-complete.text:
Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned! 

Now, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... the recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.
96403-complete.title: Important Heirlooms

96626-complete.name: Tomas
96626-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96626-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97917-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97917-accept.text:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97917-accept.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97965-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97965-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97965-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97970-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97970-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97970-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

97970-complete.name: Messana Crestwind
97970-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97970-complete.title: Camping 101: Mining

98285-accept.name: Strange Hermit
98285-accept.text:
An engineer is ever-resourceful, and if you are in the wilds alone, it's always good to be able to put your trade to use. No good camp is complete without a few helpful constructs!

Yes, come back and see me when you've gained a little bit of experience as an engineer and I can show you how to make something special!
98285-accept.title: Camping 101: Engineering

98423-complete.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-complete.text:
Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.

As you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... and the Dark Irons did not.

Thank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, $c.
98423-complete.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98512-accept.name: Fendaal Windstone
98512-accept.text:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
98512-accept.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

99127-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99127-accept.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight, go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127-accept.title: A Net Disaster

99127-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99127-complete.text: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.
99127-complete.title: A Net Disaster

99128-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99128-complete.text: I can hear their warbling from here, it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.
99128-complete.title: Slimy Menace

99129-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
99129-complete.text:
I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.

I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.
99129-complete.title: A Man About a Murloc

99130-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
99130-complete.text:
Give me just a minute...

It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.
99130-complete.title: An Enticing Offer

99131-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
99131-accept.text:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.
99131-accept.title: Baited for Success

99143-complete.name: Lee Brown
99143-complete.text:
An interesting collection. These should work well enough!

Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.
99143-complete.title: Bottles and Baubles

99260-accept.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
99260-accept.text:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
99260-accept.title: Fillion's Mission
